outreach_operator.name: Outreach operator
outreach_operator.description: Runs outreach campaigns: creates and edits them, starts and cancels them, and rewrites drafted emails. Reads prospects, emails, the pipeline log and the do-not-contact list. Cannot approve, skip or send emails.

outreach_approver.name: Outreach approver
outreach_approver.description: Everything the operator does, and decides what goes out: approves or skips emails, sends the approved ones, and keeps the do-not-contact list.
